description: Get the full Overture Maps record for a single place by its ID. Returns all available fields: names, addresses, coordinates, confidence score, categories, websites, phones, social profiles, emails, and brand. Place IDs are returned by the search_places, reverse_geocode, and find_nearest_place tools.

id.description: Overture place identifier (format: "overture:place:<uuid>"), returned in the id field of any search result.

name: get_place_by_id
